absences.action: Schedule attendance review. Contact parents. Check for underlying issues.

failures.action: Enrol in remedial classes. Assign academic mentor.

studytime.action: Provide structured study plan. Recommend study groups.

G1.action: Arrange extra tutoring. Weekly check-ins with subject teacher.

G2.action: Urgent intervention. Refer to counsellor. Discuss with HOD.

grade_trend.action: Monitor weekly. Identify what changed between periods.

avg_grade.action: Full academic review with HOD. Personalised learning plan.

study_efficiency.action: Check home study environment. Recommend library.
